company.name: SOMOS
company.shortDescription: SOMOS is a toolkit for building a fractional career in social impact.
company.description: SOMOS is a platform that helps mission-driven professionals, social impact leaders, equity professionals, founders, and consultants build flexible, independent careers. It provides tools for selling services, managing clients, and tracking revenue without recruitment fees or commissions. The platform includes positioning support, pricing tools, editorial planning, invoicing, and strategy resources. SOMOS also offers ownership tokens, allowing contributors to earn a stake in the platform.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $15,503, or 7.66% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,323,501 to $5,495,652, a 4.15x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 36 (-7 over 90 days) and market heat at 50 (-8).
